card.name: Mwanzele
card.tagline: Mijikenda/Giriama coastal funeral dance of Kenya
card.profile: Mwanzele is a dance style originally performed during funerals by the Mijikenda (notably the Giriama) people of Kenya's coastal region (Wikipedia). Described as a slow, poetic dance performed by elders, it is accompanied by songs telling stories of history, wisdom and life lessons. Popular performers include the late Bini Ya Mama and Bin Hare, while Mohamed Ngana ('Nyerere wa Konde') of the Malindi area became a leading composer who used the genre for public-health messaging.
card.insight: Mwanzele is a building block of coastal 'bango' music, a fusion of jazz, rhumba and Mijikenda traditional styles; its singers shifted from performing for fame to professional, recorded careers in recent decades (Wikipedia; Jumuiya News).
